index uq_connect_ref_grant on connect_ref_grants: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `uq_connect_ref_grant` ON `connect_ref_grants`(`role_id`,`connector`,`ref_prefix`)
index ux_access_request_approver on access_request_approvals: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `ux_access_request_approver` ON `access_request_approvals`(`request_id`,`approver_id`,`approver_machine_identity_id`)

trigger trg_permissions_generation_delete on permissions: CREATE TRIGGER trg_permissions_generation_delete AFTER DELETE ON permissions FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO system_metadata (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('role_permissions_generation', '0', datetime('now')); UPDATE system_metadata SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT) WHERE key = 'role_permissions_generation'; END
trigger trg_permissions_generation_insert on permissions: CREATE TRIGGER trg_permissions_generation_insert AFTER INSERT ON permissions FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO system_metadata (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('role_permissions_generation', '0', datetime('now')); UPDATE system_metadata SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT) WHERE key = 'role_permissions_generation'; END
trigger trg_permissions_generation_update on permissions: CREATE TRIGGER trg_permissions_generation_update AFTER UPDATE ON permissions FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO system_metadata (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('role_permissions_generation', '0', datetime('now')); UPDATE system_metadata SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT) WHERE key = 'role_permissions_generation'; END
trigger trg_role_permissions_generation_delete on role_permissions: CREATE TRIGGER trg_role_permissions_generation_delete AFTER DELETE ON role_permissions FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO system_metadata (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('role_permissions_generation', '0', datetime('now')); UPDATE system_metadata SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT) WHERE key = 'role_permissions_generation'; END
trigger trg_role_permissions_generation_insert on role_permissions: CREATE TRIGGER trg_role_permissions_generation_insert AFTER INSERT ON role_permissions FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO system_metadata (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('role_permissions_generation', '0', datetime('now')); UPDATE system_metadata SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT) WHERE key = 'role_permissions_generation'; END
trigger trg_role_permissions_generation_update on role_permissions: CREATE TRIGGER trg_role_permissions_generation_update AFTER UPDATE ON role_permissions FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO system_metadata (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('role_permissions_generation', '0', datetime('now')); UPDATE system_metadata SET value = CAST(CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT) WHERE key = 'role_permissions_generation'; END
trigger trg_secret_nodes_cache_epoch on secret_nodes: CREATE TRIGGER trg_secret_nodes_cache_epoch AFTER UPDATE ON secret_nodes FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.cache_epoch = OLD.cache_epoch BEGIN UPDATE secret_nodes SET cache_epoch = OLD.cache_epoch + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id; END
